_comment: Project-level settings for the Research Agent Teams machine. The two PreToolUse hooks are the machine's safety rails (mirrors of tools/scope_guard.py + validate_artifact.py). BOTH NO-OP off a run: permission-scope-guard only acts when RAT_RUN_ID is set (an active fenced worker), artifact-contract-enforcer only acts on *.artifact.json writes; both fail OPEN on internal error. So normal editing in this folder is never blocked.
